name: model-rounds-gate
cmd:
set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; set +e; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.model-rounds.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; T=$?; bun test --timeout 120000 kernel/model-rounds.test.ts kernel/model-confirmation.test.ts kernel/model-sequence.test.ts kernel/prove-memo.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; U=$?; bun research/bapa/model-rounds-probe.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/probe.log" 2>&1; P=$?; bun test --timeout 120000 $(find ./kernel -maxdepth 1 -name '*.test.ts' | sort) > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/kernel.log" 2>&1; K=$?; GDP_EPR=0 GDP_SET_FIRST=0 bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa/model-confirmation-public.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/public.log" 2>&1; R=$?; printf '%s
' 'feat(prove): configure model refinement rounds' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/message.txt" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1; L=$?; printf 'kernel=%s public=%s lint=%s
' "$K" "$R" "$L" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/extra-checks.txt"; printf 'types=%s tests=%s probe=%s
' "$T" "$U" "$P" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/checks.txt"; test "$T$U$P$K$R$L" = 000000
